sources.label: morphe patches for kakaotalk/dcinside
sources.author: Ample
patch_list: Removes Ad Balloon banners displayed over the live player.
Removes the VOD companion and search banner ads.
Removes the ads inserted between clips in the Catch feed by reporting no ad slots.
Removes the ad area shown in the app-exit confirmation dialog, keeping the dialog itself.
Removes the image, video and cinema intro ad banners shown on launch.
Removes the native banner ads under the live player and in feeds by stopping their ad request, so no banner is fetched or shown.
Removes the live pre-roll ad by routing every ad decision into the app's own no-video path so the stream starts immediately.
Removes the banner ads shown under the live player by stopping their driver from attaching the banner fragments.
Removes the native "main board" banner ad shown in feeds and under the live player.
Removes VOD pre-roll ads by reporting every stream as QuickView Plus to the player's own ad-skip check.
